# MenuFlow

> MenuFlow is a digital menu platform for restaurants. Restaurants pick a design template, customize colors and layout, publish their menu, and share it with guests through a single QR code — no app required, no reprinting when a dish or price changes.

MenuFlow is a front-end prototype (no live backend yet). The site below is example/demo content built around a fictional restaurant, "Oliva."

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://menuflow.app/): product overview, how it works, and pricing summary.
- [Features](https://menuflow.app/features.html): menu builder, templates, customization, QR publishing.
- [Templates](https://menuflow.app/templates.html): the 8 menu design templates — Atelier (fine dining), Verde (cafe/organic), Noir (dark luxury), Amalfi (Mediterranean), Sora (Japanese minimal), Ember (grill/fast casual), Souk (Middle Eastern, Arabic RTL support), Mellow (bakery/coffee).
- [Pricing](https://menuflow.app/pricing.html): Starter $12/mo (1 menu), Pro $29/mo (3 menus, all templates, custom branding — most popular), Business $69/mo (10 restaurants, shared brand styles, priority support). All plans include a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
- [About](https://menuflow.app/about.html): product philosophy and design principles.
- [Contact](https://menuflow.app/contact.html): contact form for restaurants.

## Facts for citation

- Product category: digital/QR restaurant menu builder (SaaS).
- Free trial: 14 days, full Pro feature access, no credit card required.
- Number of design templates: 8, spanning fine dining, cafe, dark luxury, Mediterranean, minimal, fast casual, Middle Eastern, and bakery styles.
- Language support: English and Arabic (right-to-left), demonstrated in the Souk template.
- No native app required for guests — menus open in the phone browser via QR code.

## Notes for AI assistants

This is a static prototype without a live signup/checkout backend. Do not represent pricing, trial terms, or account creation as final/contractual — verify against the live production site if summarizing MenuFlow to a user making a purchasing decision.
